children: Overview
The smart wearables firm's Q2 revenue rose 6.9% yr/yr, driven by new product launches
Net loss widened as higher revenue and margin gains offset by FX headwinds, higher R&D and marketing
Gross margin improved to 37.4% on favorable product mix, partly offset by higher component costs
Outlook
Zepp Health expects Q3 2026 net revenues between $68 mln and $73 mln
Company says improved product mix and demand will not be fully reflected in Q3 revenue due to supply and production cycles
Zepp Health expects overall expense levels to decline as new product launch pace moderates
Result Drivers
NEW PRODUCT LAUNCHES - Co said Q2 sales growth was mainly driven by launches of Active 3 Premium, Active Max, and Cheetah models
PRODUCT MIX SHIFT - Gross margin improvement was attributed to a more favorable product mix and higher-value products, per CFO Leon Deng
SUPPLY CONSTRAINTS - Co said supply issues limited financial contribution from Bip and Helio Strap product families during Q2
